user_query: I'm planning a beach vacation with my family next month. Can you suggest some popular beach destinations? Also, provide me with the carbon footprint of a round-trip flight from Los Angeles to each destination. Additionally, recommend some healthcare mailing services that can help me promote my beach resort.

TaskList.description: Fetch a list of popular beach destinations for family vacations.
Calculate the carbon footprint of a round-trip flight from Los Angeles to each of the suggested beach destinations.
Find healthcare mailing services that can help promote a beach resort.
